newsitems.title: Apex Legends™: Marked
newsitems.author: Electronic Arts
newsitems.contents: [h3]This season, Bloodhound evolves into the ultimate predator, World’s Edge shifts with new POIs, and Corrupted Attachments arm every squad for the hunt. The gods are watching, prove you deserve their favor. [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38098458/86df38bb82a94f5de3e192627baa6ad02085ff1e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The Hunter of Legends[/b] [/p][p]Blessed by the Allfather, Bloodhound evolves from skilled tracker to lethal hunter. Follow the trail with an improved Passive, keep prey in sight with longer Tactical scans, and strike from the shadows with the new Allfather’s Cloak Ultimate. [/p][p][b]Fresh Hunting Grounds[/b] [/p][p]World’s Edge shifts, bringing new hunting grounds, old-god aesthetics, and aurora borealis glowing in the night sky. Stalk your prey through 3 new POIs: East Village and its massive Longhouse, the War Camp arena, and the towering Tree Settlement. Old favorites return too: Sorting Factory is back and Stacks re-emerges in Fragment. [/p][p][b]The Weapon Chooses the Hunter[/b] [/p][p]Your loadout walks the line between predator and prey. Corrupted Attachments introduce new late-game power with a real tradeoff, while visible weapon stats show exactly how each attachment changes your gun. Streamlined loot bins make looting faster and simpler: spend less time perfecting your loadout and more time using it. [/p][p][b]The Pack Grows Stronger[/b] [/p][p]Loba keeps the squad supplied with a faster Tactical and an improved Black Market, which now has a quicker cooldown and drops EVO Orbs. Rampart bolsters the defense, moving faster while firing Sheila and building tougher walls in less time. [/p][p][b]Chosen by the Gods[/b] [/p][p]A true weapon of the gods. The Allfather’s Fury Mythic CAR channels the power of the old gods, and has 5 customization tiers unlockable with Exotic Shards. Available as a possible drop in the Marked Seasonal Pack. [/p][p][b]Claim Your Trophies[/b] [/p][p]Go hunt with the Marked Premium Battle Pass. Earn Legendary skins for Bloodhound and Caustic, a Legendary Mozambique Weapon Skin, 10 Exotic Shards, and the Reactive R-301 at Tier 60. [/p][p][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.author: RSPN_Bean
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]INTRO[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to the latest season of Apex Legends: MARKED. In addition to Bloodhound’s rework, buffs to Loba and Rampart, an energy weapon systems overhaul, and brand new Corrupted Attachments, we’re also bringing you a World’s Edge map rework, quality of life tweaks, and a slew of balancing changes. All of this is in pursuit of evolving Apex Legends into the best, most competitive Battle Royale out there. This season is going to push you and your squad to be the best you can possibly be, so get ready to group up, gear up, and dive into MARKED when it drops on August 4th, 2026![/p][h2][b]MATCHMAKING TESTS[/b][/h2][p align="start"]In Season 29, we ran two matchmaking tests — 1-Tier Premade Restrictions and Diamond+ Solo-Queue-Only — to experiment with variables to potentially use to address player frustrations in Ranked. Thank you to everyone who engaged with the tests and for the feedback you provided; it’s integral to helping us shape the future of the game mode. We are actively analyzing and evaluating the data from these tests, and are in the process of writing an upcoming blog to discuss the results and next steps. Keep an eye out for the followup comms in the coming weeks.[/p][h2][b]SERVER STABILITY[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We've beefed up our servers in Season 30. While not everyone will notice the difference, many players should experience increased stability, less lag, and lower chances of slo-mo servers across all game modes and regions. We're always working to improve the competitive experience for our players and, while these changes often take place behind the scenes, we’re excited to provide a noteworthy improvement for you all![/p][h2][b]GAME UPDATES[/b][/h2][h3][b]World’s Edge[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: We feel World’s Edge is in a solid place competitively, and have seen the sentiments echoed throughout the community, so our focus in updating the map was reducing disparity between POIs and delivering on players’ frequently requested changes, such as the return of Sorting Factory and Construction Stacks. To complement Bloodhound’s rework, we leveraged the new POIs in this update to move Bloodhound’s story forward in a meaningful way.[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]East Village[/b][/p][list][*][p]East Village: Added additional rock and tree cover in open areas around the POI[/p][/*][*][p]East Village: Modified the terrain at the base of the Dam for less punishing traversal[/p][/*][*][p]East Wildcard [/p][/*][*][p]Divided Moon Wildcard [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Revamped Power Journey[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Over the lifetime of Apex, Looting has changed substantially. A rising problem we wanted to address with these changes was the loot inflation and ease that players have around finding very high quality loot. In many cases, progressing through a match could feel like a quick spike at the beginning or mid point of the match and quite flat afterwards.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]We’ve overhauled several systems that were added over the past few years to shape a more engaging and straightforward loot chase for players. The spawn rates of high tier loot have been reduced across all maps, meaning that finding a rare Attachment will be a ‘rarer’ occurrence, and will signal a real shift in the power of your weapon.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]Arsenals provide a consistent way to get the guns you want, but can disrupt the game start by luring players into hot drop contests in the open spaces around Arsenals. Arsenals are now time locked, similar to EVO Harvesters. This ensures that they are available early game when you want them, but that your earliest fights off the drop are supplied only by what you can loot from the map. Unique loot sources such as Wildlife, Vaults, MRVNs, Ticks, and Rollers are still present but provide reduced quality of loot.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i]TL;DR:[/i] [i]Spawn rate of high tier loot has healing and ammo when killed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][i]**For more information about the design approach and intention behind weapons systems and Legends changes, please read our recent[/i] [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/news/30-0-designers-notes"][i]Designer’s Notes[/i][/url][i].[/i][/p][h3][b]UI Stat Overhaul[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: We are updating how Weapon Stats are shown in game to improve transparency and readability of gameplay in Apex. You can now explore with greater detail than ever the unique stats and performance characteristics of each weapon. By exposing these stats and allowing players to examine how different attachments impact weapon performance, players can make more informed choices in-game quickly. Presenting this greater information with visual refinements is part of our effort to improve Onboarding and clarity of gameplay for all players.[/i][/p][p align="start"]While in Lobby:[/p][list][*][p]New Playground tab available via Legend Locker > Weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Allows for you to preview information about the weapon, what attachments can go on the weapon, and how those attachments affect that weapon’s stats.[/p][list][*][p][i]Changes here do not affect any in-game weapon behaviors.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]While looking at a weapon or attachment in the world or inventory:[/p][list][*][p]Weapon Loot Cards:[/p][list][*][p]The loot card now shows a detailed breakdown of a weapon’s damage, ideal range, rate of fire, firing modes and weapon specific gameplay information.[/p][/*][*][p]When looking at a weapon to swap, the loot card now shows a quick comparison between the weapon you are holding and the weapon you would pick up.[/p][/*][*][p]Can be disabled by changing Interact Prompt Style from Default to Compact.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2YpT1TWUyyw4tid9iMOhZ6/165f6d01a7f1a379c301b4b02af201de/08..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.614453125,yPosition=0.4895833333333333" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Attachment Loot Cards:[/p][list][*][p]For attachments that can be equipped onto your weapon, the loot card now shows the stat change that will occur when equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Can be disabled by changing Interact Prompt Style from Default to Compact.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5k8erUMwGRC1CLIRT6A8dI/8d57f1ff3779f4b3ff7537d5d4ea33d5/07..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.634375,yPosition=0.4388888888888889" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h3][b]Corrupted Attachments[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Corrupted Attachments provide players with a meaningful choice when they are equipping their guns. Providing a unique blend of big buffs and negative stat trade offs will reshape a weapons performance and specialize its power. Limited to one Corrupted Attachment per weapon, players must make tactical decisions about their preferred loadouts. Need an absolute bullet hose for those close range fights? Put the Overflowing Mag on the R-99 for easier one-clips at the cost of longer reloads. Or do you want more maneuverability and speed? Put the Agile Standard Stock on the R-99 instead for increased movement speed at the cost of reduced mag size.[/i][/p][p align="start"]New High Tier Attachment Rarity[/p][list][*][p]Each Corrupted Attachment comes with a unique bonus and negative effect[/p][/*][*][p]Only 1 Corrupted Attachment can be equipped on a gun at a time[/p][/*][*][p]5 New Attachments[/p][list][*][p]Overflowing Magazine[/p][list][*][p]Improves magazine size beyond that of a Purple Magazine[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces weapon reload speed[/p][/*][*][p]Can be attached to any weapon that accepts a Magazine[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Headseeker Barrel[/p][list][*][p]Increases weapon Headshot Damage[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces Hipfire Accuracy[/p][/*][*][p]Improves recoil at the same level as the Purple Barrel[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tactical Laser[/p][list][*][p]Improves Reload Speed[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces ADS Recoil Control[/p][/*][*][p]Improves Hipfire Accuracy at the same level as the Purple Laser Sight[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Agile Standard Stock[/p][list][*][p]Eliminates weapon move speed penalty[/p][/*][*][p]Increases weapon ADS move speed[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces Magazine Size[/p][/*][*][p]Improves Reload Speed and Weapon Handling at the same level as the Purple Standard Stock[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rapid Sniper Stock[/p][list][*][p]Increases weapon Rate of Fire[/p][/*][*][p]Reduces Magazine Size[/p][/*][*][p]Improves Reload Speed and Weapon Handling at the same level as the Purple Sniper Stock[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Corrupted Attachments can be found in[/p][list][*][p]The core loot pool with a low spawn chance[/p][/*][*][p]Round 2 and 3 care packages[/p][/*][*][p]High tier loot locations (Worlds Edge Vaults, Icarus Ship Bridge, Etc.)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Energy Ammo Rework[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: We're taking a big swing with energy weapons this season and really shaking up their ammo systems. We've removed energy ammo entirely as a lootable item. The goal of this change was to provide another way to think about your weapon loadout choice, and why you are picking one weapon over another. To lean into their unique energy identity these weapons will now come with their own regenerating ammo pool. Removing the need to hunt for extra ammo or spend valuable inventory space opens up new loadout opportunities, but keep an eye on that stockpile - once it's run dry players will have to wait for it to regenerate. With replenishing ammo, we expect energy weapons to be most powerful in shorter fights, but start to lose ground in longer sustained engagements.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Energy Ammo boxes removed from the game[/p][/*][*][p]Energy Weapons come with a stockpile of ammunition[/p][list][*][p] Similar to the Bocek or Care Package Weapons[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Energy Weapon Stockpile Size is comprised of multiple magazines worth of ammo[/p][list][*][p]Each weapon comes with[/p][list][*][p]Havoc: 3 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]Nemesis: 3 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]Devotion: 3 Magazines worth of stockpile [/p][/*][*][p]L-Star: 4 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]RE-45: 2 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]Volt: 2 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][*][p]Triple Take: 2 Magazines worth of stockpile[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]If the weapons magazine size increases, the stockpile total updates to match[/p][list][*][p]ex. A Volt with no extended magazine has a maximum Stockpile size of 40[/p][/*][*][p]ex. A Volt with a Purple Magazine has a maximum Stockpile size of 54[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Energy Weapons regenerate a magazines worth of ammo over 18 seconds[/p][list][*][p]Regeneration time does not increase if your magazine size increases[/p][list][*][p]ex. A Volt with no extended magazine attachment equipped regenerates 20 shots over 18 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]ex. A Volt with a Purple Magazine equipped regenerates 27 shots over 18 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Regeneration pauses while shooting or reloading the weapon[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A new HUD element has been added for energy weapons. This displays how many magazines worth of ammo you have left.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7dhehko1aXDZTdtoK10XGo/b6084ae8193a2c8648ea3eba3338f466/03..png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6283048211508554,yPosition=0.6086956521739131" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Weapon HUD now displays Energy Ammo count as a percentage[/p][list][*][p]A setting has been added to swap between percentage or bullet count[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tunings for Wildcard[/p][list][*][p]Energy Weapons get 1 additional mag worth of stockpile ammo[/p][/*][*][p]Energy Weapons regenerate a magazine's worth of ammo over 12 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]Volunteer Jumpmaster[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev note: Core to Apex is the Drop Ship experience, it is not only the game’s start, but it also influences a team's odds for success. A successful jump can be the difference between a top placement in a match and a quick trip back to the lobby. Timing and positioning your team for a good Drop is a skill check, and it is a responsibility that some players prefer to have in their direct control. Volunteering for Jumpaster empowers the more experienced and adventurous players who want to shape the start of their team’s game.[/i][/p][p align="start"]In game modes with a Jumpmaster, during Character Select, players can now volunteer to be Jumpmaster. This adds a deterministic way for players to take on the responsibility of being the Jumpmaster for their team. [/p][p align="start"]During Character Select[/p][list][*][p]When Volunteering is active, players will see an option to ‘Opt In To Jumpmaster’.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can press the corresponding button to Volunteer at any time during Character Selection. [/p][/*][*][p]Players who have Opted In to Jumpmaster will be marked on the UI in Character Select.[/p][/*][*][p]Players who volunteer for Jumpmaster on a match will be Opted In to Jumpmaster for future matches. [/p][/*][*][p]Players can use the same button press to Opt OUT of volunteering if they have previously Opted IN. [/p][/*][*][p]If more than one team member has Volunteered, Jumpmaster will be selected randomly from the group of Volunteers. [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Purrfect Pals[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The Marked Battle Pass Free Track features a meaningful weapon charm, Purrfect Pals, starring two adorable cats.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5tLXIQss7BWPQlN52r0SzY/3670fb5bcc6ca24eb8c375c8492109dd/04..png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.38011695906432746,yPosition=0.5896531452087007" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]This charm was created to honour a former Respawn developer, Benjamin Sklar, who passed away last year, and was inspired by the things that were most meaningful to him, including his two beloved cats, Tia and Sophia. Our friend embodied a strong sense of social justice and fairness. He loved astronomy, travel and photography. His special interests included quantum physics and personal finances. We miss him dearly, but we are comforted knowing his legacy can live on in Apex Legends. Welcome to the Apex Games, Tia and Sophia.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to top[/i][/p][h2][b]Mythic CAR: Mark of the Gods[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Marked by the gods. Earned by the hunter. [/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5kCfJQXElShBn5zznzczNA/d5e69d7642e4b2df05907fb8003357c8/05..png?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.37994791666666666,yPosition=0.46435185185185185" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The Marked Seasonal Pack* brings Bloodhound-inspired divinity with a chance to unlock the “Allfather’s Fury” Mythic CAR. 5 customization tiers unlock through Exotic Shards, from base form through feather and wing evolutions, with Knock FX, Ordnance FX, and final rethemes. [/p][p align="start"]*Not available in all regions.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to top[/i][/p][h2][b]LEGENDS[/b][/h2][h3][b]BLOODHOUND[/b][/h3][p align="start"][i]Dev Note: Despite changes to Bloodhound’s kit in Season 28, they remain nearly invisible at middle-to-high tiers and have the lowest pick rate once you get to Gold tier and above. Luckily, we teased additional changes, and it’s finally time to show off Bloodhound’s refreshed kit. The biggest change is a brand new Ultimate, Allfather’s Cloak. This is a multifaceted cloaking tool that will help your squad ambush opponents or escape third-party situations. Combined with easier-to-use tracking tools from your Passive and Tactical, it’s much easier to gain an understanding of the battleground and then push in when enemies show weakness. The hope is that Bloodhound players feel like they can now play from the front foot, leading their squad and creating openings instead of just scanning some enemies and hoping your allies can take advantage.[/i][/p][p align="start"][b]Passive[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bloodhound can now see a red trail near fresh enemy clues to guide you to them[/p][list][*][p]This is similar to the red footsteps Bloodhound would see in their previous ultimate, Beast of the Hunt.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]To reduce visual clutter, many types of clues have been removed. Traversal clues and Eliminations are the only ones that remain.[/p][list][*][p]Trails and clues now get hidden when the owner dies, except the Player Killed clue[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted some of the black raven behavior to help them spawn more reliably, and included information about how they work to the ability description[/p][/*][*][p]White ravens can fly up to 400m (was previously 190m baseline, 380m with Raven's Flight)[/p][/*][*][p]You can now activate white ravens remotely by looking at them for a short time[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Tactical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tactical now full-body scans for 3 seconds (was a 2 second full-body scan with 2 more seconds of a diamond scan)[/p][/*][*][p]After the full-body scan finishes, create 4 "snapshot" scans with 1.5s in between them[/p][/*][*][p]If a scan hits a white raven and at least one enemy, cooldown no longer partially refunds[/p][list][*][p]If a scan hits a white raven and no enemies, it still refunds the full cooldown[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][b]Ultimate[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Ultimate: Allfather’s Cloak[/p][/*][*][p]Throw down a device that cloaks anyone who gets within range[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/21AhTW7rsgFCNpxuYmGmun/7105c0b1dffc8fff5dc051f35c71a09b/06.__1_.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6230398069963812,yPosition=0.37291280148423006" style="box-sizing: border-box; newsitems.contents: [h2][b]TL;DR[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Below, we’ll provide insight into meta changes coming in our next season, Marked.  We’ll discuss our goals and rationale for the changes for each of the following:[/p][list][*][p]Bloodhound’s Rework[/p][/*][*][p]Loba’s Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Rampart’s Buff[/p][/*][*][p]Valkyrie’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Axle’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Seer’s Nerf[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon UI Stats Overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]NEW Corrupted Attachments[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped Power Journey[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]INTRODUCTION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Welcome to Designer’s  Notes for our next season - MARKED. We appreciate all the time you spent playing in the most recent season, and the feedback that you’ve provided. Using your feedback and our internal match data, we have been hard at work, tuning and adjusting to get ready for our next update.[/p][p align="start"]This season we are excited to bring a much anticipated update to Bloodhound. We know there has been a lot of chatter about giving them a refresh and we are finally ready to reveal all the hard work that has gone into making Bloodhound a more competitively viable pick amongst the Legend roster. However, Bloodhound isn’t the only Legend getting updates. We have incoming buffs for Rampart and Loba to help make them more attractive picks, and changes to Valkyrie, Seer, and Axle to assuage some player frustrations.[/p][p align="start"]We have [i]significant[/i] changes coming to weapons and loot this season. We’ve refreshed our weapon and attachment UI to better help you understand the effects of each potential piece in your arsenal. Speaking of attachments, we are adding a new wave of attachments called “Corrupted Attachments.” These attachments have powerful buffs, but also noteworthy drawbacks. We are looking to create interesting risk-reward choices around the attachment meta and we’re excited to see how you leverage them in your in-game strategy.[/p][p align="start"]In another big change: we are removing energy ammo from the loot pool. That’s right, energy weapons will now regenerate their ammo. This was done in an effort to create a unique way of playing with energy weapons and to give you more options for how you decide to manage your backpack. With this change, we are looking to provide more variety of choice and player expression, and want to see how you integrate this new system into your squad’s strategy.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you for all the time you spend playing Apex. We appreciate all the feedback you give and look forward to hearing from you on what you think of our latest update. See you in the dropship![/p][h1][b]LEGEND BUFFS[/b][/h1][h2][b]BLOODHOUND REWORK[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Back in Season 28, we brought in a package of buffs to help Bloodhound’s pick rate while we worked on some bigger changes intended to make Bloodhound a more viable pick at all skill levels.  Despite those changes, Bloodhound remains nearly invisible at middle-to-high tiers; they have the lowest pick rate once you get to Gold tier and above. It’s been a long time coming, but we’ve made substantial changes to each ability in their kit to help you truly live out the true hunter fantasy.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5u549qZkVAGqQmQHFJvjxC/b745b2f01cca3bf23388aeaab8048c31/01_Plat__Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Bloodhound_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Plat+ Ranked gameplay from 11-1-2025 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound’s passive creates lingering trails behind enemies that you can follow to track and eliminate your opponents. You can also activate your White Ravens more easily by glancing at them for a short time.[/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound’s Tactical now shows additional “snapshot” scans after the initial scan finishes, increasing the amount of time you can track enemy locations (without being a full wallhack). [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Bloodhound is boasting a brand new Ultimate: Allfather’s Cloak. Activating their Ult will deploy a device that cloaks everyone — squadmates and enemies — who approaches it. The cloak persists for 12 seconds after leaving the Ult’s space and breaks after using your weapons or taking damage. While you aren’t [i]fully[/i] invisible, you are much harder to see and track, allowing you to set ambushes for enemy squads or escape tricky situations.  [/p][h3][b]New Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Hidden Sight:[/b] refreshes your Tactical when you use your Ultimate, and hides your scanning pulse from enemies while cloaked allowing you to survey the scene without notifying enemies to your whereabouts[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bird’s Eye:[/b] allows your White Ravens to split off and mark two different enemies at the same time, identifying your two nearest threats[/p][/*][*][p][b]True Predator:[/b] allows you to recloak after firing your weapon, enhancing your ability to hit-and-run after using your Ultimate.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]LOBA[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Loba’s loot-oriented kit has seen her popularity decline over time, particularly as amps and arsenals provide other ways to build healthy loadouts. While we expect Loba’s usefulness to rise with the loot changes coming in season 30 (more on that below), it still felt like she could use additional buffs to help keep her relevant.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6LLKtz5YC6Z9gEEXkVTkqa/4e93b3bc63888896709d303843642386/03_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Loba_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.34296875,yPosition=0.4949074074074074" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked and Trios gameplay from 10-1-2024 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The main change we’re making to Loba is reducing how long it takes to deploy her Tactical. - We’re reducing the activation time from 0.6s to 0.4s, increasing the projectile speed by ~30% so it lands more quickly, and adding a 15% range increase.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To make Loba’s Ult a bit more alluring, we’re shaving some time off of its cooldown, bringing it down from 150s to 120s, to help your squad stay ahead of other squads in terms of resources as the game progresses.[/p][h2][b]RAMPART[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Despite significant changes in Season 27, Rampart remains near the bottom of pick rate graphs at every skill level. While she can be particularly powerful in late-game when set up in a great spot, her setup still feels slow and she’s too challenging to play throughout most of a match. As such, we have a handful of changes we’re making to hopefully pull up her pick rate a bit.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/1HzdGoLCKv3vUophCPK4An/2009ced73df35fce56475390bb62e8ab/02_Overall_Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Rampart_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.28854166666666664,yPosition=0.4847222222222222" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][h3][b]Passive[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rampart is gaining a new element to her Battle Modder passive: she progresses Locked Hop-Ups 50% faster to unlock more powerful weapons earlier in the match.  [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We have increased the health of Rampart’s walls, particularly at earlier EVO levels.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Rampart is also getting a movement buff for her Ultimate: she now moves significantly faster while spinning up or shooting Sheila.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]LEGEND NERFS[/b][/h1][h2][b]VALKYRIE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Everyone’s favorite fighter pilot has remained in a strong position for a while now. As we work to manage power creep in our game, we felt Valk could use some slight nerfs to bring her in line.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5m4Z1u4LEctARtApdg3VGL/328e5a3bc048061ed931b09cee8f3af1/04_Plat__Legend_Pick_Rate_-_Valk_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.5,yPosition=0.5" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked gameplay from 8-1-2025 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][p align="start"]Our first goal is to reduce her “artillery” potential - she can do significant poke damage from long range while having extra utility and mobility that others don’t.  [/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]We’re reducing her missile damage, as well as adjusting the trajectory of her missiles so they can’t get over top of high cover as easily.  [/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Additionally, we want to reduce her Ultimate’s ability to keep her and her squad far above the fight while also knowing exactly where everyone is. To accomplish this we’re lowering the height by 15% and nerfing two Upgrades. [/p][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Eye in the Sky:[/b] Reduced through-wall scans base distance to 100m[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supersonic:[/b] Slightly nerfed the speed improvement when blasting off from 2.5 seconds to 3.0 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]AXLE[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Axle’s pick rate has been trending in a healthier direction with each subsequent nerf following her race to the top on release. Her Kickstart drone is still too oppressive in too many contexts, and we’re continuing to evaluate how to increase counterplay opportunities. Now that she’ll be affected by her own ult, Axle players should think twice before deploying it in close-quarters skirmishes. She can no longer stack two Ult charges, and we’ve reined in the overall range that players can super slide with her Nitro Gates. Quantitative data isn’t everything; we’re still keeping a close eye on player sentiment when it comes to Nitro Gate and Kickstart usage and will continue to adjust if needed.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/7hpnBHwpDBVsUwnjNKgnLo/632e6db69b1305fd775e4178ab90f5a4/05_Share_of_Total_Selections_-_Axle_v1.jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.30859375,yPosition=0.47962962962962963" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][i]*Data from Ranked gameplay from 5-1-2026 through 7-6-2026[/i][/p][h3][b]Tactical[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To restrict the range that players can slide, we’re reducing the max slide boost time from 5 seconds to 3 seconds.[/p][h3][b]Ultimate[/b][/h3][p align="start"]To force players to be more selective when choosing to use Axle’s Ult, it will now affect self & allies (similar to Mad Maggie, Bangalore, and Gibraltar ultimates)[/p][list][*][p]Axle (self) gets damaged, stunned, and displaced (same as enemies)[/p][/*][*][p]Allies get stunned and displaced, but won’t take damage[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Upgrades[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Replace Automata with [b]Long Haul[/b], which brings the Tac max slide time back up to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Shuffled order[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl 2: Sliding Shooter vs Long Haul[/p][/*][*][p]Lvl 3: Jump Gate vs Super Slider[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]SEER[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Seer’s back in the spotlight after our most recent round of buffs, and he’s been hard to ignore! Seer is a tricky Legend to balance, frequently yo-yo-ing between the absolute bottom and top of pick rate charts. He’s on a knife’s edge where a buff will either do very little, or make him entirely OP.[/p][p align="start"]The last time Seer hit the heights of the top 3 Legends in terms of pick rate, he dropped off on his own naturally after about a week. It seems our Artist-in-Residence has more staying power this time around, and not everyone is a fan.[/p][p align="start"]We already took a swipe at Seer’s Tactical uptime by reworking his Upgrade tree as part of a quick hotfix after the mid-season split. His new Level 3 Upgrade choices are much more evenly split than they were before in terms of pick-rate.[/p][p align="start"]However, it seems like Tactical uptime alone wasn’t the root of the problem, and we needed to roll back some of the new strength of the Tactical. Specifically, turn slow (slowing the rate at which you can rotate your Legend) was added to his ability at the mid-Season split, which was the straw that broke the camel’s back in terms of frustration. As a result, we will be making the turn slow much more subtle in Season 30.[/p][p align="start"]Our intent with Seer, and other ‘counter-movement’ Legends was to give tools to players that can counter the more mobile Legends of the roster. However, it seems like in practice all Legends were getting caught in Seer’s net. We will revisit how we implement these kinds of slows in the future to try and be more targeted towards just the speediest Legends of our cast.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h1][b]WEAPONS & LOOT[/b][/h1][h2][b]UI STAT OVERHAUL[/b][/h2][p align="start"]“What does a stock do?” This is the question the weapons team has been answering for the past 7 years. Sure, there is technically a block of text on each and every stock that reads out what it is actually doing to your weapon when you equip it, and let’s be honest, no one is reading that when a team has hot dropped next to you. It’s time to provide way more transparency around what each and every attachment actually does to your weapon when you go to equip it, and how the weapon itself measures up against every other weapon in the game, and we’re doing it in a few different ways.[/p][p align="start"]The lobby has received an update in the form of a new Playground tab under each weapon category. Players can quickly see at a glance a weapon’s stats, as well as how they change with a combination of all available attachment types.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/6r2bFqMsOgJrBwYVEEe8CA/75a43023f0cb04bfd8f73b741ec79749/06..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.1484375,yPosition=0.4236111111111111" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In-game, players will see brand new weapon and attachment loot cards, as well as a new inventory hover state which shows a weapon’s stats and how each attachment affects them.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/5k8erUMwGRC1CLIRT6A8dI/8d57f1ff3779f4b3ff7537d5d4ea33d5/07..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.634375,yPosition=0.4388888888888889" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2YpT1TWUyyw4tid9iMOhZ6/165f6d01a7f1a379c301b4b02af201de/08..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.614453125,yPosition=0.4895833333333333" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In implementing these changes, our main goals were to help with the onboarding of Apex’s weapon and attachment systems, to provide more clarity on how weapons work — their strengths and weaknesses — and how attachments affect their ability to perform in combat. Once a player has mastered the weapon and attachment system, they will always have the option to enable Compact UI mode and reduce the amount of information that is being displayed in-game.[/p][p align="start"]Now, feel empowered to enter into a game knowing full well what a stock does.[/p][h3][b]CORRUPTED ATTACHMENTS[/b][/h3][p align="start"]What better way to show off our new attachment UI than with some new attachments! Corrupted Attachments have entered the Apex Games.[/p][p align="start"][img src="https://drop-assets.ea.com/images/2iFMUBt5kKplxiHrK7z08x/0a8147dd3b73343ceeb4748560d3bd2b/09..jpg?im=AspectCrop=%2816,9%29,xPosition=0.6171875,yPosition=0.4847222222222222" style="box-sizing: border-box; display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; height: 451.125px; width: 802px;"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Corrupted Attachments are powerful items that can be equipped onto your weapons, providing them with some serious stat buffs, at the cost of reducing another. Kiss-Curse, if you will. Only one Corrupted Attachment can be equipped to a weapon at a time.[/p][p align="start"]Why Corrupted Attachments? We wanted to provide a new vector for choice and strategy when it came to picking and defining your weapon loadout. Since attachments were previously a linear upwards stat progression, the choice around your loadout often began and ended with the weapon itself. Now, you are poised with a strategic choice when you locate a Corrupted Attachment: Do I take this for a powerful upside at a cost? Or do I leave it for the next person to come along?[/p][h3][b]REVAMPED POWER JOURNEY[/b][/h3][p align="start"]“Cool, Corrupted Attachments, where can I find them in the loot pool?” Short answer: high-tier loot locations. Long answer… Well, let’s talk about what a high-tier loot location really is.[/p][p align="start"]Like we talked about before, Apex Legends is in its 7th year, and we have made many changes to our loot over that time. Loot has been our main carrot at the end of the stick for many of our systems, and thus loot creep has become a real issue. Your looting experience, your power journey, has become quite flat, often with large early game spikes of high tier loot into a pretty substantial flatline.[/p][p align="start"]We want your power journey to feel more consistent over the course of a match, and for those moments when you find a purple mag off drop to feel powerful once again. To accomplish this, we are taking a huge swing at re-balancing our loot pools and loot delivery systems. Next season you will see an overall reduction in the quality of loot that is spawned. The quantity of loot is unchanged. What this means is that where once you could find a plethora of purple and gold tiered items in a normal POI, those have been replaced with white and blues, with the occasional chance at those top-tier purple items. Similarly, a lot of our readily accessible loot delivery systems like loot rollers and Arsenals are seeing a similar change.[/p][p align="start"]“So where are those Corrupted Attachments you were talking about?” Similar to purple items, you will rarely find them in the standard loot pool, with a significantly higher chance of them spawning in our rarer or single use loot delivery systems. For example, hitting up Trials on World’s Edge will yield a much higher chance at getting those purple loot items or Corrupted Attachments. The idea is that while the quality of loot has been reduced across the map, those special loot locations like vaults, Icarus’s Bridge, and certainly care packages, will be your new vector for your best chances at those high tier loot rolls.[/p][p align="start"]There are a ton of updates coming that are under the umbrella of this change, all of which will be covered in detail in the patch notes, but here are a few of the major ones to be on the lookout for:[/p][list][*][p][b]ALL MAP LOOT TABLES:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][*][p][b]ARSENALS:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][*][p][b]EXTENDED SUPPLY BINS & WEAPON SUPPLY BINS:[/b] Removed[/p][/*][*][p][b]LOOT BIN RESET:[/b] Reworked[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]ENERGY AMMO REWORK[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Last but not least, we have upcoming changes to how Energy Weapons work![/p][p align="start"]Energy Weapons now come with a regenerating stockpile of ammo. Once players use this ammo, over time, and while the weapon is idle, the ammo will begin to regenerate its supply in the weapon, allowing you to continue the fight without needing to manually loot to replenish.[/p][p align="start"]The goal of this change was to provide another way to think about your weapon loadout choice, and why you are picking one weapon over another. Are you grabbing a Volt because you dropped hot and don’t have time to worry about looting ammo? Or is it because you need those inventory slots to carry extra meds for your teammates? [/p][p align="start"]This rework is not exclusive to the BR; all Energy Weapons across the BR, Mixtape and Wildcard will see this change in effect.[/p][p align="start"][i]Back to Top[/i][/p][h2][b]CONCLUSION[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We hope this blog has been helpful in deepening your understanding of the dev team’s decision making processes behind implementing new systems and making balancing changes. For a thorough change log of everything coming in Marked, be sure to check out the full Patch Notes, dropping on August 3rd, 2026![/p][p align="start"][url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/buy"]Play Apex Legends for free[/url]* now on PlayStation®4, PlayStation®5, Xbox® One, Xbox® Series X|S, Nintendo Switch™ 2, and PC via the EA app, Epic, and Steam.[/p][p align="start"]Follow Apex Legends™ on [url="https://twitter.com/PlayApex"]Twitter/X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/playapex/"]Instagram[/url], and [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@PlayApex"]TikTok[/url], subscribe to our [url="https://www.youtube.com/playapex%20"]YouTube channel[/url], and check out our [url="https://answers.ea.com/t5/Apex-Legends/ct-p/apex-legends-en"]forums[/url].[/p][p align="start"]Sign up for our [url="https://www.ea.com/games/apex-legends/apex-legends/newsletter"]newsletter[/url] today to receive the latest Apex Legends news, updates, behind-the-scenes content, exclusive offers, and more (including other EA news, products, events, and promotions) by email.[/p][p align="start"]This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content. We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible. For more information, please refer to EA’s Online Service Updates at [/p][p][url="https://www.ea.com/service-updates"]https://www.ea.com/service-updates[/url][/p][p align="start"].[/p][p align="start"]*Applicable platform account and platform subscription (sold separately) may be required. A persistent internet connection and EA account required. Age restrictions apply. Includes in-game purchases.[/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][/p][previewyoutube="jJObfZSbzAw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Bloodhound claims the Allfather's blessing, becoming the hunter of Legends: stalking their prey with improved tracking and striking from the shadows with a new Ultimate. Claim new territory in the updated World's Edge, sharpen your arsenal with Corrupted Attachments, and tap into new power with Loba and Rampart buffs. [/p][p]Be the predator, or become prey. [/p][p]Learn more: [url="http://x.ea.com/apxl/marked"]http://x.ea.com/apxl/marked[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
